title: a scheduler that declares what a run costs
description: The planted violation: a run's cost in the document of a component that will not spend it. The scheduler could then hold a run against one number while the run occupied another, and neither document would be wrong on its own terms.

topics.description: A topic naming where the cost is published is NOT a declaration of it — the scheduler subscribes here in the real tree, and the gate must not read that as the fault. Present so the exemption is exercised rather than assumed.
